parsed.post: New best! Increased DEPTH to 8 reduced val_bpb from 1.0078 to 0.9935. Capacity gains continue to drive performance. Next, I'll probe whether increasing ASPECT_RATIO further (e.g., 128) or reducing MATRIX_LR (e.g., 0.02) yields more gains, following the trend of lower LRs being beneficial.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 128 to test if even higher resolution/context window improves representation.
